However, prospective consultants should note that we expect the duration of each step of the project implementation to be similar to the current outline.

scope_of_deliverables.value: BCI is seeking a consultant to carry out a Scope of Work reviewing its training cascade model as part of its ISEAL five-year capacity strengthening review, including what to retain, adapt, or redesign and how the Behaviour Change Wheel or similar behaviour change approach should be integrated. The shown Scope of Work lists expected outputs including a benchmarking review of other ISEAL capacity-strengthening models, co-design and delivery of an online Programme Partner survey, and webinars/consultations to deepen findings.
scope_of_deliverables.quote:
Scope of Work

This review will enable BCI, as part of its ISEAL five-year review of capacity strengthening, to decide what to retain, adapt, or redesign in the training cascade model — recognising that the answer may differ by country — and how the Behaviour Change Wheel or similar behaviour change approach should be integrated.

vendor_experience_required.value: At least 5 years' experience evaluating or designing farmer training, extension, or training-of-trainers programmes in smallholder and medium farm agriculture; demonstrated survey design and analysis experience including working across languages; experience producing practical recommendations for programme improvement. Optional qualifications include ISEAL/comparable certification scheme familiarity, behaviour change framework knowledge, and experience in one or more BCI direct countries.

data_security_requirements.quote:
BCI will therefore provide the consultant with relevant existing data at kick-off, including anonymised assurance findings and practice adoption indicators, and survey findings should be checked against these. Options for change should be assessed for their expected impact on farmer practice adoption, cost and effort to implement, and feasibility across differing country contexts.

• Co-design and run an online survey of Programme Partners (translated as needed) covering: how the cascade operates in practice, where knowledge transfer weakens, actual use of the Behaviour Change Wheel or similar, what digital channels PPs and farmers currently use and PP views on the feasibility of digital delivery direct to farmers in their context, and what PPs would change. The consultant will review BCI’s suggested questions and propose amendments for BCI approval prior to launch. Responses are confidential to the consultant with BCI only receiving anonymised responses.
